officialPortals.title: Visa and migration portal of the Republic of Kazakhstan

links.title: Visa and migration portal of the Republic of Kazakhstan

docs.text: Visa application form with colour or black-and-white photo 3.5 x 4.5 cm
Number and date of the invitation registered with the Ministry of Internal Affairs or MFA of Kazakhstan (e-Visa requires an invitation number)
Valid passport with at least 2 blank visa pages, valid at least 3 months beyond the requested visa
Original payment document for the consular fee or state duty
Additional documents required for the visa category (Appendix 1 of the visa rules)
Foreign-issued documents (criminal record certificate, diploma) legalized unless a treaty provides otherwise
Issued e-Visa printed for border control; entry/exit only through the international airports of Astana and Almaty
